curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What lessons in trust, loyalty, and love await rambunctious toddlers on their Paris journey?
curatedMovie.description: A rambunctious group of toddlers heads across Paris from the Eiffel Tower to Notre Dame, learning about trust, loyalty, and love.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Lighthearted and lively family animation that offers an easy-watching, breezy Parisian romp.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Brisk, bright, and easy to share with family, this animated escapade pairs high-energy toddler comedy with a landmark-hopping adventure.
